*Last updated: 2026-04-10.*
**The single source of truth for what Strale-the-company is working on.** Not just product features — anything that needs to be done. Categories as inline tags: product / gtm / ops / content / infra / personal. Status: now / next / later / done.
**Rule:** action items from sessions go here. Not inline in canonical pages. Not in memory. Not in session summaries. The To-do DB is the only place where active work accumulates.
**Done = move to archive.** When a to-do is completed, move it to Archive \> Completed To-dos. The To-do DB is a live work queue, not an archive. Session history lives in the Journal; completed work lives in git. The goal is zero outstanding items.
---
# Ideas Under Evaluation
Ideas that have passed the "interesting" threshold but aren't ready to become To-do items. Each needs evaluation before it earns a spot on the build plan. Not brainstorms (those go to Journal DB). Not committed work (that goes to To-do DB). The middle ground.
